title.en: Fable 3 — The Tortoise and the Hare

sentences.en: The hare was the fastest one in the forest.

sentences.ar: كل يوم بيقول: أنا أسرع واحد.
sentences.en: Every day he said: I am the fastest.
And laughed at the slow ones.
And the slowest in the forest was the tortoise.
One day, he said to her: tortoise!
Are you walking or standing still?
The tortoise said: I am walking.
